items.question: Do you travel outside Boise?
items.answer: Yes! We regularly provide luxury rentals throughout Boise, Meridian, Eagle, Nampa, Caldwell, and surrounding areas for weddings, corporate events, parties, and private celebrations.

items.question: What types of events do you serve?
items.answer: We provide luxury rentals for weddings, corporate events, birthday parties, school dances, brand activations, galas, holiday parties, baby showers, and private celebrations throughout the Treasure Valley.

items.question: How far in advance should I book my rental?
items.answer: We recommend booking your rental as early as possible, especially for weddings and peak event weekends throughout Boise. Popular dates can book several months in advance.

items.question: Can you match my event theme?
items.answer: Absolutely! We offer custom overlays, premium backdrops, glam filters, neon signs, hedge walls, shimmer walls, and personalized design options to perfectly match your event aesthetic and branding.

items.question: Do you set up and operate the booth during the event?
items.answer: Yes! Our team handles delivery, setup, operation, and breakdown so you can enjoy a seamless, stress-free experience from start to finish.

items.question: Dimensions
items.answer: We need at least 10 by 10 feet of space, access to a single power outlet, and level ground. Please note that our backdrop stands are 8 feet tall.

items.question: Can guests instantly share their photos?
items.answer: Yes! Most of our experiences include instant text, email, AirDrop, or QR code sharing so guests can post and share their photos immediately.

items.question: Do you offer custom branding for corporate events?
items.answer: Yes! We offer fully branded experiences including custom overlays, branded start screens, lead capture, logo placement, and social sharing features perfect for corporate activations and marketing events.

items.question: Why choose your rentals?
items.answer: Our luxury experiences combine premium technology, studio-quality imagery, modern styling, and interactive entertainment to create unforgettable moments for guests throughout Boise.
